govt_add.name: IOE entrance (BE and B.Arch)
govt_add.need: +2 Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, at least 45 percent or grade C in each
stages: 100 objective questions, 140 marks, 2 hours. Wrong answers lose 10 percent of the question marks.
Seats go by entrance rank. Pick a campus and subject at counselling.
prep: Revise the +2 Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics syllabus chapter by chapter
Practise computer based mock tests, the real exam is on a screen
Mathematics carries the most marks, so give it the most hours
govt_add.note: Check the notice of the exam body for dates, fees and seats. They change every year. Students waiting for the +2 result may apply.

govt_add.name: BSc CSIT entrance
govt_add.need: +2 Science, or +2 with Mathematics and Computer
govt_add.body: Institute of Science and Technology, Tribhuvan University
stages: 100 multiple choice questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. No negative marking. Pass mark 35 percent; good colleges expect much more.
Colleges fill seats in merit order.
prep: Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry carry 75 of the 100 marks
Do timed 2 hour model papers from the IOST notice page
Leave nothing blank, there is no negative marking
govt_add.note: Check the notice of the exam body for dates, fees and seats. They change every year. The 2083 round took forms from 22 July to 1 August 2026 and held the test on 9 August 2026.

govt_add.name: MECEE-BL (MBBS, BDS, nursing, pharmacy)
govt_add.need: +2 Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, at least 50 percent and the minimum grade in each
stages: 200 single best answer questions, 200 marks, 3 hours. 0.25 marks off for each wrong answer. Pass mark is the 50th percentile.
Seats for MBBS and BDS are listed by merit, with scholarship and quota rules in the notice.
prep: Biology is 80 marks, keep it first
Practise negative marking, guess only when you can drop two options
Take at least 10 full length papers before the exam
govt_add.note: Check the notice of the exam body for dates, fees and seats. They change every year.

govt_add.name: CMAT (BBA, BBS, BHM and related)
govt_add.need: +2 in any stream, grade C or above in English
stages: 100 objective questions on verbal ability, quantitative ability, logical reasoning and general awareness.
Many colleges add these rounds before the final merit list.
prep: Practise reasoning and basic maths daily
Read one English newspaper article a day
Do timed model papers
govt_add.note: Check the notice of the exam body for dates, fees and seats. They change every year. Colleges set their own extra rounds. The 2083 round took forms from 15 June to 4 August 2026 and held the test on 8 August 2026.

govt_add.name: CTEVT diploma entrance
govt_add.level: Diploma entrance for health, engineering and agriculture
govt_add.need: SEE pass, with the subject grades the programme asks for
stages: Objective test on science, mathematics and English at SEE level.
Seats include scholarship quotas for public colleges.
prep: Go through the SEE science and maths books again
Practise past questions from the CTEVT site
govt_add.note: Check the notice of the exam body for dates, fees and seats. They change every year. Programmes such as Health Assistant, Civil engineering and Computer engineering each publish their own notice.

govt_add.name: IELTS
govt_add.level: English test for study, work and migration
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Universities set the band they need
prep: Take one full practice test first to see your band
Write two essays a week and get them marked
Record yourself for the speaking round
govt_add.note: Scored in bands from 0 to 9. Results are valid for 2 years. Tests run through the year in Kathmandu and other cities.

govt_add.name: PTE Academic
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Universities set the score they need
prep: Learn the template for each task type
Practise on a computer with a headset
Time yourself, the screen moves on
govt_add.note: Scored from 10 to 90, results usually come within days. Valid for 2 years.

govt_add.name: TOEFL iBT
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Universities set the score they need
prep: Check ets.org for the current format and score scale, it changed recently
Practise with the official ETS tests
Read academic articles daily
govt_add.note: Taken at a test centre or at home. Valid for 2 years. Mostly asked by universities in the USA and Canada.

govt_add.name: Duolingo English Test
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Check that your university accepts it
stages: About one hour taken online at home, with a short video interview and writing sample.
prep: Practise on a quiet computer with a good webcam
Do the free practice test first
govt_add.note: Scored from 10 to 160. Valid for 2 years. Cheapest of the main English tests, but not accepted everywhere.

govt_add.name: JLPT (Japanese)
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. N5 is the easiest, N1 the hardest
govt_add.body: Japan Foundation and Japan Educational Exchanges and Services
prep: Learn hiragana and katakana first
Finish a level book per level
N4 is the usual minimum for a Japanese language school visa
govt_add.note: Held once or twice a year in Kathmandu, so register early. Nepal workers and students also use JFT-Basic and NAT-TEST.

govt_add.name: TOPIK (Korean)
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. TOPIK I is level 1 to 2, TOPIK II is level 3 to 6
prep: Level 3 is the usual minimum for most universities
Learn Hangul in the first week
Practise listening every day
govt_add.note: Dates in Nepal are published each year by the exam centre. Workers going through the government route sit a separate EPS-TOPIK.

govt_add.name: German (Goethe, telc, TestDaF)
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Study visas usually ask for B1 or B2
prep: Take the course level by level, A1 to B2 takes around a year
Book the exam before you finish the course, seats fill early
govt_add.note: Certificate level is on a scale from A1 to C2. Check the university and embassy page for the level you need.

govt_add.name: HSK (Chinese)
govt_add.need: No fixed minimum. Level 1 is the easiest
prep: Learn pinyin and tones early
HSK 4 is often asked for degree study in China
govt_add.note: Chinese government scholarships usually ask for HSK 4 or HSK 5, depending on the programme.
